TheArdentBlade.description: The first time each turn that <style="Faction_Sisterhood">Celestine</style> defeats an enemy unit, she resurrects one of her <style="Faction_Sisterhood">Geminae Superia</style> with <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style> in a free adjacent hex. If they cannot be resurrected, then one of them within {[range]} hexes takes an action instead.
